allowed.audit_logs: Append-only audit log. Written by log_user_action / audit_profile_access while pages load; holds no business data the demo user could change.
allowed.security_audit_logs: Append-only security log. get_advertisement_contact_info writes a row when a page reads contact details.
allowed.integration_audit_logs: Append-only. get_user_integrations_safe writes a row each time the Integrations cards load.
allowed.banking_audit_logs: Append-only. get_bank_accounts_safe writes a row when the finance assistant reads bank accounts.
allowed.payment_audit_logs: Append-only. get_user_payments writes a row when payments are read.
allowed.trial_email_log: Append-only send log of the trial emails (written by the trial email sender with the service role).
allowed.notifications: Notification read state: the Notifications panel marks items read (UPDATE of own rows only).
allowed.user_notification_preferences: Per-user notification preferences. get_notification_preferences inserts the default row on load (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING still fires BEFORE INSERT triggers).
allowed.notification_type_prefs: Per-user notification preferences (on/off per type). No business data.
allowed.user_favorites: Per-user UI favourites. No business data.
allowed.user_favorite_tools: Per-user favourite tools in the tool list. No business data.
allowed.demo_readonly_users: Created by this proposal. No client privileges at all; only the owner (SQL editor) or the service role writes it.
